functions.name: beginps
functions.purpose: Write the PostScript document prolog and initialize its graphics state.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point calculations; output depends on stored bounding-box state.

functions.name: endps
functions.purpose: Write the PostScript trailer and page count.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point calculations; output depends on stored document state.

functions.name: begineps
functions.purpose: Write the encapsulated PostScript prolog.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point calculations; output depends on stored bounding-box state.

functions.name: endeps
functions.purpose: Write the encapsulated PostScript trailer.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point calculations; output depends on stored bounding-box state.

functions.name: boundingbox
functions.signature: void boundingbox(int llx, int lly, int urx, int ury);
functions.purpose: Store the document bounding box for later output.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Integer state only.

functions.name: newpage
functions.purpose: Write a PostScript page comment and increment the page count.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Integer state only.

functions.name: showpage
functions.purpose: Emit the PostScript showpage command.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point calculations.

functions.name: gsave
functions.purpose: Emit the graphics-state save command.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point calculations.

functions.name: grestore
functions.purpose: Emit the graphics-state restore command.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point calculations.

functions.name: newpath
functions.purpose: Emit the new-path command.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point calculations.

functions.name: closepath
functions.purpose: Emit the close-path command.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point calculations.

functions.name: clip
functions.purpose: Emit the PostScript clipping command.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point calculations.

functions.name: translate
functions.purpose: Emit a coordinate translation.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Floats are promoted to double for printf and formatted with seven significant digits; locale affects output.

functions.name: scale
functions.purpose: Emit a coordinate scaling command.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Floats are promoted to double and formatted with four significant digits; locale affects output.

functions.name: rotate
functions.purpose: Emit a coordinate rotation in degrees.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: The float is promoted to double and formatted with four significant digits; locale affects output.

functions.name: concat
functions.purpose: Emit a six-element PostScript transformation matrix.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Matrix floats are promoted to double and formatted with four significant digits; locale affects output.

functions.name: setgray
functions.purpose: Emit a grayscale color command.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: The float is promoted to double and formatted with four significant digits; locale affects output.

functions.name: setcymkcolor
functions.signature: void setcymkcolor(float cyan, float magenta, float yellow, float black);
functions.purpose: Emit the source's four-component setcymkcolor command.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Floats are promoted to double and formatted with four significant digits; preserve the source command spelling.

functions.name: setrgbcolor
functions.signature: void setrgbcolor(float red, float green, float blue);
functions.purpose: Emit an RGB color command.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Floats are promoted to double and formatted with four significant digits; locale affects output.

functions.name: setcolor
functions.purpose: Resolve a named or X11-style hexadecimal color and emit its RGB values.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: The private color lookup divides integer components by a float denominator and stores float results; case conversion and hexadecimal parsing have C-library behavior.

functions.name: setlinewidth
functions.purpose: Emit a line-width command.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: The float is promoted to double and formatted with four significant digits; locale affects output.

functions.name: setlinejoin
functions.purpose: Emit a line-join style command.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Integer output only.

functions.name: setdash
functions.signature: void setdash(float dash[], int ndash, float offset);
functions.purpose: Emit a dash pattern and offset.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Each float is promoted to double and formatted with four significant digits; the loop preserves array order.

functions.name: moveto
functions.purpose: Emit an absolute move command.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Coordinates are formatted with four significant digits after float-to-double promotion.

functions.name: rmoveto
functions.purpose: Emit a relative move command.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Coordinates are formatted with four significant digits after float-to-double promotion.

functions.name: lineto
functions.purpose: Emit an absolute line command.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Coordinates are formatted with four significant digits after float-to-double promotion.

functions.name: rlineto
functions.purpose: Emit a relative line command.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Coordinates are formatted with four significant digits after float-to-double promotion.

functions.name: arc
functions.signature: void arc(float x, float y, float r, float ang1, float ang2);
functions.purpose: Emit a circular arc command.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Arguments are formatted with four significant digits after float-to-double promotion.

functions.name: stroke
functions.purpose: Emit the path-stroking command.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point calculations.

functions.name: fill
functions.purpose: Emit the path-filling command.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point calculations.

functions.name: show
functions.purpose: Emit a PostScript string-display command.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point calculations; the string is emitted without PostScript escaping.

functions.name: justshow
functions.purpose: Emit PostScript to display a string with the specified justification.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: The justification float is formatted twice with four significant digits; the actual positioning is computed by PostScript.

functions.name: image
functions.signature: void image(int w, int h, int bps, float m[], unsigned char *samples);
functions.purpose: Emit a hexadecimal grayscale image and its PostScript image setup.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Matrix floats use four-significant-digit formatting; integer row-byte arithmetic and 39-byte output chunks determine encoding.

functions.name: rgbimage
functions.signature: void rgbimage(int w, int h, int bpc, float m[], unsigned char *samples);
functions.purpose: Emit a hexadecimal RGB image and its PostScript colorimage setup.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Matrix floats use four-significant-digit formatting; integer row-byte arithmetic and 39-byte output chunks determine encoding.

functions.name: setfont
functions.purpose: Emit PostScript to select and scale a font.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: The size is promoted to double and formatted with four significant digits.

functions.name: fontbbox
functions.signature: void fontbbox(const char *fontname, float fontsize, float bbox[]);
functions.purpose: Return the scaled bounding box from the font metrics table.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Preserve the table values, unknown-font fallback, and C multiplication and conversion order involving FONTSCALE.

functions.name: fontheight
functions.purpose: Return the scaled maximum height from the font metrics table.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Integer metric difference is converted to float before scaling; preserve FONTSCALE promotion and assignment order.

functions.name: fontwidth
functions.purpose: Return the scaled maximum width from the font metrics table.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Integer metric difference is converted to float before scaling; preserve FONTSCALE promotion and assignment order.

functions.name: fontcapheight
functions.purpose: Return the scaled font cap height.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Preserve metric-table values and multiplication and conversion order involving FONTSCALE.

functions.name: fontxheight
functions.purpose: Return the scaled font x-height.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Preserve metric-table values and multiplication and conversion order involving FONTSCALE.

functions.name: fontdescender
functions.purpose: Return the scaled font descender metric.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Preserve metric-table values and multiplication and conversion order involving FONTSCALE.

functions.name: fontascender
functions.purpose: Return the scaled font ascender metric.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Preserve metric-table values and multiplication and conversion order involving FONTSCALE.

functions.name: polyline
functions.signature: void polyline(const float *x, const float *y, int n);
functions.purpose: Draw a polyline, stroking and restarting its path every 200 points.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Coordinates are passed through unchanged; output formatting occurs in the drawing functions.

functions.name: markto
functions.signature: void markto(float x, float y, int index, float size);
functions.purpose: Draw one of the supported marker shapes at a position and size.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Marker coordinates are fixed float literals; size is formatted to four significant digits and PostScript performs the line-width division.

functions.name: rectclip
functions.signature: void rectclip(float x, float y, float width, float height);
functions.purpose: Set a rectangular clipping path.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Width is negated in float arithmetic; coordinate formatting is delegated to drawing functions.

functions.name: rectfill
functions.signature: void rectfill(float x, float y, float width, float height);
functions.purpose: Draw a filled rectangle within a saved graphics state.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Width is negated in float arithmetic; coordinate formatting is delegated to drawing functions.

functions.name: rectstroke
functions.signature: void rectstroke(float x, float y, float width, float height);
functions.purpose: Stroke a rectangle within a saved graphics state.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Width is negated in float arithmetic; coordinate formatting is delegated to drawing functions.

functions.name: psAxesBox
functions.signature:
void psAxesBox(
	float x, float y, float width, float height,
	float x1Beg, float x1End, float p1Beg, float p1End, 
	float d1Num, float f1Num, int n1Tic, int grid1, char *label1,
	float x2Beg, float x2End, float p2Beg, float p2End,
	float d2Num, float f2Num, int n2Tic, int grid2, char *label2,
	char *labelFont, float labelSize,
	char *title, char *titleFont, float titleSize,
	char *titleColor, char *axesColor, char *gridColor,
	float ticwidth, float axeswidth, float gridwidth,
	int style);
functions.purpose: Draw a styled two-dimensional PostScript axes box with ticks, grids, labels, and title.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Repeated float tick increments determine loop termination and placement; double literals, log10 and pow are mixed with float assignments, exponent casts, and printf formatting. Zero or wrongly signed increments and zero divisors can cause invalid results or nontermination.

functions.name: psAxesBBox
functions.signature:
void psAxesBBox(
	float x, float y, float width, float height,
	char *labelFont, float labelSize,
	char *titleFont, float titleSize,
	int style, int bbox[]);
functions.purpose: Estimate an integer bounding box for a two-dimensional axes box.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Expressions mix float inputs and double literals before conversion to int, which truncates toward zero for representable values.

void psAxesBox3(

functions.name: psCubeAxesBox
functions.signature:
void psCubeAxesBox(
	float x, float y, float size1, float size2, float size3, float angle,
	float x1Beg, float x1End, float p1Beg, float p1End, 
	float d1Num, float f1Num, int n1Tic, int grid1, char *label1,
	float x2Beg, float x2End, float p2Beg, float p2End,
	float d2Num, float f2Num, int n2Tic, int grid2, char *label2,
	float x3Beg, float x3End, float p3Beg, float p3End,
	float d3Num, float f3Num, int n3Tic, int grid3, char *label3,
	char *labelFont, float labelSize,
	char *title, char *titleFont, float titleSize,
	char *titleColor, char *axesColor, char *gridColor);
functions.purpose: Draw a projected three-dimensional cube axes box with ticks, grids, labels, and title.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Repeated float tick increments affect termination and positions; sin and cos operate in double on the radian angle, with results assigned to floats or passed to float parameters. Double literals, %.4g labels, and platform math-library rounding affect output; invalid increments or divisors can cause nontermination or invalid values.
